review: Root, independent Sol and Astra source review; Astra verified retained validation and approved this scoped checkpoint
behavior: One shared final selected-profile and held-image birth fence serves the existing PTY wrapper and a dormant stdio entry point.
Stdio accepts explicit file descriptors and its own process group; Stop check, Start and child registration share the existing signal mutex.
Publication sync runs outside that mutex. Publication failure returns the live unwaited child for caller containment and one Wait.

meaningful_omissions: Final selected-profile admission bypass caused the stale-selection assertion to fail.
Omitting server pending Stop allowed a late Start and failed the intended assertion.
Registering the child after held publication sync prevented timely containment and failed the intended assertion.
linux_synthetic.fake_agent_setup: A fixed private go shim copies the exact Root-built fake-agent ELF for TestMain; no remote source/toolchain/cache changes.

limits: Linux positive mechanics used a copied synthetic Go ELF and process-group signals, without the race detector. Mac race skips do not establish positive Linux race coverage.
Native stream protocol, managed-descendant and authenticated socket Stop, a stalled Start deadline, native assets/workflows, restart and account adoption remain separate gates.
No native chat activation, automatic effects, complete parent feature or full repository quality-gate claim.
